Análisis multivariante

Grupo 2.4

2025-04-13

ACM de las variables cualitativas

Lectura de datos

Es necesario estar en el directorio de trabajo desde el que se leen los datos, los cuales pertenecen al primer archivo csv generado mediante el algoritmo Mice.

library("FactoMineR")
## Warning: package 'FactoMineR' was built under R version 4.4.2
library("factoextra")
## Warning: package 'factoextra' was built under R version 4.4.3
## Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.4.3
library("corrplot")
## Warning: package 'corrplot' was built under R version 4.4.3
StudentPerformanceFactors_1 <- read.csv("StudentPerformanceFactors_1.csv")

datos<-StudentPerformanceFactors_1[, c(3,4,12,13,5,8,14)]

Identificar categorías con baja frecuencia

for (i in 1:ncol(datos)) {
  plot(as.factor(datos[,i]),
       main = colnames(datos)[i],
       ylab = "Count",
       col = "steelblue",
       las = 2)
}

prop.table(table(datos$Teacher_Quality)) * 100
## 
##     High      Low   Medium 
## 29.86227 10.12562 60.01211
res.mca <- MCA(datos, method="Indicator", graph = FALSE)

Screeplot selección de dimensiones

fviz_screeplot(res.mca, addlabels = TRUE)

eig.val <- get_eigenvalue(res.mca)
eig.val
##        eigenvalue variance.percent cumulative.variance.percent
## Dim.1   0.1536370         8.962161                    8.962161
## Dim.2   0.1522435         8.880870                   17.843031

## Dim.4   0.1476692         8.614039                   35.076271
## Dim.5   0.1455503         8.490434                   43.566705
## Dim.6   0.1442022         8.411797                   51.978502
## Dim.7   0.1415274         8.255767                   60.234269
## Dim.8   0.1403291         8.185864                   68.420132
## Dim.9   0.1385961         8.084770                   76.504902
## Dim.10  0.1364018         7.956772                   84.461675
## Dim.11  0.1355693         7.908212                   92.369887
## Dim.12  0.1308019         7.630113                  100.000000
sum(eig.val[, "eigenvalue"] > 1/7)
## [1] 6
which(eig.val[, "eigenvalue"] > 1/7)
## Dim.1 Dim.2 Dim.3 Dim.4 Dim.5 Dim.6 
##     1     2     3     4     5     6

Planos factoriales

var <- get_mca_var(res.mca)
var
## Multiple Correspondence Analysis Results for variables
##  ===================================================
##   Name       Description                  
## 1 "$coord"   "Coordinates for categories" 
## 2 "$cos2"    "Cos2 for categories"        
## 3 "$contrib" "contributions of categories"
fviz_mca_var(res.mca, choice = "mca.cor",repel = TRUE,ggtheme = theme_minimal())

fviz_mca_var(res.mca, repel = TRUE, ggtheme = theme_minimal())

Incluyendo individuos

plot(res.mca, col.ind = "grey", cex=0.6)

Calidad de representación CALIDAD DE LA REPRESENTACIÓN

fviz_mca_var(res.mca, col.var = "cos2", gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),repel = TRUE, ggtheme = theme_minimal())

corrplot(var$cos2, is.corr=FALSE)

fviz_cos2(res.mca, choice = "var", axes = 1:2)
